FX-SELBLUR-001.says: Skin beside shadow with no line between, both chosen, blur 6: the edge turns into a soft ramp across the whole row, the same on every row.

FX-SELBLUR-002.says: The same at blur 0: the drawing, untouched.

FX-SELBLUR-003.says: The same with only the shadow chosen: it has no chosen colour beside it to mix with, so nothing changes.

FX-SELBLUR-004.says: Skin and shadow with a black line between, both chosen: the line is not chosen, so neither colour reaches the other and nothing changes.

FX-SELBLUR-005.says: Skin, shadow and highlight, with skin and shadow chosen: the skin and shadow edge goes soft; the highlight stays exactly as drawn, and none of it mixes into the shadow.

FX-SELBLUR-006.says: The halves as a block on nothing, with black chosen as well: nothing stays nothing, even though its colour is black, and the soft edge reaches no further than the block.

FX-SELBLUR-007.says: The halves with the top four rows half covering: every pixel keeps its own covering, and its colour is FX-SELBLUR-001's.

FX-SELBLUR-008.says: The halves with the skin chosen one step off in blue (#f6d6bf) beside the shadow: the skin is not chosen, so nothing changes.

FX-SELBLUR-009.says: Blur keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 12 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is FX-SELBLUR-002, frame 2 is FX-SELBLUR-001, frame 4 is the blur at 12.

FX-SELBLUR-010.says: FX-SELBLUR-001 moved two pixels right: the same softened drawing, moved; the blur is done on the drawing's own pixels before it is moved.

FX-SELBLUR-011.says: Blur 5.5: a blur is a whole number of pixels, and a half rounds up, so this is FX-SELBLUR-001.

FX-SELBLUR-012.says: Skin above a sloping edge, shadow below, blur 12: the edge goes soft all along its length.

FX-SELBLUR-013.says: The same at blur 64, where all five passes act.

FX-SELBLUR-014.says: No colours chosen: nothing changes. An effect just added has none.

FX-SELBLUR-015.says: FX-SELBLUR-001 with its colours written in capitals: the same.

FX-SELBLUR-025.says: Skin painted unevenly, a checkerboard of skin and skin one step off in blue, beside shadow, tolerance 0: the off pixels are not chosen and stop the softening, so the skin stays as painted except the exact skin pixel touching the shadow on every other row; the shadow goes soft.

FX-SELBLUR-026.says: The same at tolerance 1: every skin pixel is chosen, and the edge goes soft across the whole row, as in FX-SELBLUR-001.

FX-SELBLUR-027.says: FX-SELBLUR-008, the skin chosen one step off, at tolerance 1: the skin is chosen again, and this is FX-SELBLUR-001.

FX-SELBLUR-028.says: The same at tolerance 0.5: one step is more than half a step, so the skin is not chosen and nothing changes. The tolerance is not rounded.

FX-SELBLUR-029.says: Skin, shadow and highlight with skin and shadow chosen, tolerance 255: every colour that shows is chosen, the highlight too, so this is the three colours chosen at tolerance 0.

FX-SELBLUR-030.says: Skin and shadow with a black line between, tolerance 255: the line is chosen too, and goes soft. A large tolerance takes in the lines.

FX-SELBLUR-031.says: FX-SELBLUR-027 with the tolerance keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 2 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing, frames 2 and 4 are FX-SELBLUR-001.

FX-SELBLUR-020.says: Blur 201, above 200. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SELBLUR-021.says: Blur -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SELBLUR-022.says: Blur keyed to 250 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SELBLUR-023.says: Nine colours, one more than eight. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SELBLUR-024.says: A colour written "#12345", one digit short. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SELBLUR-032.says: Tolerance 256, above 255. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SELBLUR-033.says: Tolerance -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
